name: claude-edit-gains-final-newline
description: The base file has no final newline. A Claude Edit rewrites the FIRST line and the file ends up with a final newline (the tool wrote one). An Edit carries no `after` fingerprint, so the engine cannot learn that the newline appeared: only the real file shows it (stage `align`). A final newline is not part of any line (the line policy), so the last line `blue` is untouched text and stays base; only line 1 is e1.
